text:
rachel: heads-up: large spike in mTLS handshake failures in eu-central at ~11:02 UTC. proxies failing to unseal certs.
jamal: saw it, lots of kms:Decrypt AccessDenied in rotator logs. Any recent RBAC runs?
sophia: yes, rbac-prune job finished at 11:00 and removed some bindings from group svc-proxy-eu-central.
lee: paste from proxy (redacted):
```
2026-03-31T11:02:18Z proxy-eu-1 ERROR cert: unseal failed: KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied for arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:123:key/rot-2024
```
oncall: scope?
rachel: impact: ingress & internal proxies in eu-central affected, some user requests failed, degraded latency elsewhere. No exfil detected.
jamal: immediate fix: revert RBAC binding. Fastest route.
sophia: opened revert PR https://git.internal/infra/rbac/pull/501, pinging infra-ops.
infra-bot: infra-ops approved revert at 11:05 UTC.
lee: binding restored 11:05:42, decrypt success returned by 11:06:10. handshake errors dropped ~95% by 11:08.
rachel: mitigation done. Actions: (1) make prune dry-run by default, (2) add pre-prune canary that runs kms:Decrypt with the actual service principal per region, (3) add RBAC allowlist for keystore/rotator/proxy groups, (4) monitoring rule: if >10% proxies in a region report kms:Decrypt AccessDenied in 2m, page infra and auto-open revert PR.
jamal: SOC notified and requested CloudTrail slice; retention extended for 60 days for this incident.
sophia: assigning RCA tasks: @lee to harden rotator backoff & cache, @jamal to update rbac pipeline guards.
oncall: closing unless recurrence observed. :white_check_mark:
